title: Affine moment derivative at zero
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite nonempty set, let $r,c\in\mathbb R$, and let $X:\Omega\to\mathbb R$. The affine moment derivative expression at $t=0$, defined as the average of $rcX(x)(1+ctX(x))^{r-1}$, equals $rc$ times the average of $X(x)$.
